100 * max by (tenant) (label_replace(sum by (namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",namespace=~"$tenant"}), "tenant", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)")) / max by (tenant) (label_replace(sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",namespace=~"$tenant"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running",namespace=~"$tenant"} == 1)), "tenant", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"))
